Shape.Name: Sheet.2
Shape.Text:
Warning: This Procedure and its associated equipment configurations are meant to provide an approximation of the correct operation of the RF Chain. It is recommended that RFT be used, to further increase the probability of hardware failure and/or its actual replacement. In addition, It is not intended to replace any of the RF amplifiers’ functional checks or calibration procedures.
SCAN AND OSCILLOSCOPE SETUP
Note: Do not rely on the internal 50 ohm capability of the oscilloscope. Use a BNC Tee and an external 50 ohm terminator, or a feed-through style 50 ohm terminator. 1. Verify scanner is in “idle”, turn off RF Enable at the Exciter (FP-I/O). 2. Disconnect the Body heliax cable, J4 “BODY OUTPUT” from the back of the Amplifier. 3.Connect the equipment as shown in the configuration you are using.
Scan Prescription Prepare the system with a test scan as follows: 1. Click on [New Pt] 2. Id: geservice <Enter> 3. Name: apb cal body <Enter> 4. Weight (Lb): 300 <Enter> 5. Set Patient Protocols to Service 6. Scroll through the protocol field until you find the protocol "3.0T apbcal". 7. From the list, select the "Body" protocol series. 8. [Accept] 9. [Save Series] 10. Select [Research Options] with the mouse cursor, and right click. Then select [Setup Params]. Set TG to 50 [Done].
